# Healthplus International

> Healthplus International is a healthcare workforce development business in Helensburgh, NSW. HPI recruits, employs and places healthcare workers across Sydney and regional NSW.

## Pages

- [Home](https://healthplusint.com.au/)
- [Employers](https://healthplusint.com.au/employers)
- [Healthcare Workers](https://healthplusint.com.au/work-with-us)
- [Positions](https://healthplusint.com.au/roles)
- [About HPI](https://healthplusint.com.au/about)
- [FAQ](https://healthplusint.com.au/faq)
- [Privacy Policy](https://healthplusint.com.au/privacy)

## Positions

Registered Nurses; Enrolled Nurses; Doctors; Assistants in Nursing; Aged Care Workers; Support Workers (community and in-home support, not NDIS); Allied Health Professionals.

## Employer enquiries

HPI acknowledges requests and contacts employers within one business day to discuss staffing needs. Employment and supervision responsibilities are described on the website and confirmed for each engagement.

## Worker registration

Upload a résumé and register in two steps. Compliance documents are requested later. Registration records work preferences; it is not a list of advertised vacancies.

## Coverage

Sydney, Central Coast, Far West NSW, Western NSW, Murrumbidgee and the Riverina, Hunter New England, Northern NSW and Mid North Coast. Regional work is planned for each engagement.
